title: Hruday route-B convergence of the uniform model's named construction and its node
accepted: In the uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) model at fixed spacing and strong bare coupling handled by route B (model AQ_uniform_routeB, labelled uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) at fixed spacing and strong bare coupling (g^4=9.6x10^9) by the AL1 dictionary tau=96/g^4 of this model; every elementary face nu=alpha tau/24, selected triple (tau/24, tau/24, tau/24); Haar reference h_b=8 sum_e C_e; whole stars phi_b (21 omitted faces, norm 7|tau|) and single-factor groups psi_b (3 selected faces, support {b}, norm at most |tau|), per-site sum J'=29|tau| (AX1 gate sha256 1b8fb152696659439bb01fc7df429fc76fa3132d4936df450d8131256015d177); both signs |tau|<=10^-8, with tau<0 the U_E mirror and no real g; coarse l-infinity metric on factor sites, a whole star of diameter 1 and a single-factor group of diameter 0; trace norm on B(H_Y); cover R={0,e_z}; Euclidean clock s=alpha t_E/hbar with G=H/alpha at the single node s=1; real-time clock theta=alpha t/hbar for the inherited limit dynamics only), with the named construction FB = centered whole-star-plus-single-group boxes Lambda_N=[-N,N]^3, N at least 2, and the finite complete-factor route-B volumes containing Lambda_N (stars inside the volume, every single group kept), every bound holding in each on-site cutoff space uniformly in the cutoff and then, at fixed N, for the untruncated ground vectors (AV1 F20-F23 with the route-B gap 1/2 of the AX1 gate; the N and cutoff limits are never exchanged): For the uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) model at fixed spacing and strong bare coupling handled by route B, at the same coupling |tau|<=10^-8, the reduced densities of the named construction (centered whole-star-plus-single-group boxes on centered coarse cubes) converge as a whole sequence on every finite region, at a rate in N that holds for every N at least 2 with the region inside the box, and to the same limit along every exhausting sequence of finite complete-factor volumes of the same prescription; this limit coincides with every AQ1 subsequential state of that construction, is invariant under coarse translations, and at tau=+10^-8 has centered Euclidean Wilson correlation C(1) within the AX2 radius of the AX2 datum at the node s=1; this is convergence of the named constructions (one family for route B), not uniqueness of any ground state, not a statement about other boundary conditions or about states outside the named construction, not weak coupling or continuum, and not a statement uniform in the lattice spacing a. Constants (exact; q=1/64; both signs; the comparisons c1B, c4B and c5B compared directly; every constant recomputed from the route-B inputs, with no hypothesis layer). T0 (tier exact_first_order, route analytic_disc on the disc |z|<=64|tau|, proved in the packet from 52 first-order faces per factor and the per-site sum 29|z|, with the route-B circle bound T_B(rho)=(52 rho/144)/(1-29*352 rho) and T_B(|tau|)=13/3599632512 equal to the AX1 gate T'): at every site u of the union volume and for every N at least 2, sum over I containing u of ||c^A_I-c^B_I|| <= K_B q^((N-|u|_inf)_+) with K_B=2T_B(64|tau|)=13/27941256 (about 4.6526e-7; margin about 2.149 against 1/1000000), in each on-site cutoff space uniformly in the cutoff (no untruncated creation coefficients are asserted). T1 and T2 (tier exact_first_order, route iterated_split with W=1024 and lambda=2/W=1/512; t_0=13/1799816256, t_W=26/3148137, beta*=132572461259098000347351859/4012775859323049054050909456204, S_lambda=2169/343): for every N at least 2, ||rho^{box1}_R-rho^{box2}_R||_1 <= C_B q^(N-1) with C_B=2326328761843649826272217312701707175/2461302090348550272620124432958434944821248 (about 9.4516e-7; margin about 4.232 against 1/250000), and for every N at least 2 and every finite complete-factor region Y inside Lambda_N, ||rho^{box1}_Y-rho^{box2}_Y||_1 <= c_site,B |Y| e^{|Y|/10^8} q^{d_Y}, d_Y=N-max_{y in Y}|y|_inf, with c_site,B=35789673259133074250341804810795495/38457845161696098009689444264975546012832 (about 9.3062e-7; margin about 2.149 against 1/500000) and C_B=c_site,B(1+q). T3 and T4 (assembly union_comparison: each M greater than N compared with N by one direct c4B comparison of Lambda_N and Lambda_M, factor 1): for every N at least 2, sup over all M greater than N of ||rho^{FB,M}_R-rho^{FB,N}_R||_1 <= C'_B q^(N-1) with C'_B=C_B (margin about 4.232 against 1/250000), and for every N at least 2 with Y inside Lambda_N, sup over all M greater than N of ||rho^{FB,M}_Y-rho^{FB,N}_Y||_1 <= c'_site,B |Y| e^{|Y|/10^8} q^{d_Y} with c'_site,B=c_site,B (margin about 2.686 against 1/400000); the nested-telescoping values C_B/(1-q) and c_site,B/(1-q) are labelled only. The limit omega_inf exists on every finite region by this Cauchy bound and trace-class completeness, without compactness, and ||rho^{FB,N}_Y-rho^inf_Y||_1 <= c'_site,B |Y| e^{|Y|/10^8} q^{d_Y} for every N at least 2 with Y inside Lambda_N. Item 2a (exhaustion within the prescription): for finite complete-factor route-B volumes V_k with N_k the largest N with Lambda_N inside V_k, for every N_k at least 2 and every finite complete-factor region Y inside Lambda_{N_k}, ||rho^{V_k}_Y-rho^inf_Y||_1 <= (c_site,B+c'_site,B)|Y| e^{|Y|/10^8} q^(N_k-max_{y in Y}|y|_inf), with c_site,B+c'_site,B=2c_site,B (about 1.8612e-6), from one direct c5B comparison of V_k with Lambda_{N_k} and the whole-sequence bound; this is exhaustion within one prescription, not a comparison of boundary conditions. Item 2b: omega^{-tau}_inf=omega^{tau}_inf o alpha_E on every finite region, from the AX1 identity U_E H_N(tau) U_E^*=H_N(-tau) in every centered box and cutoff (U_E a product of one-link unitaries) and whole-sequence convergence at both signs; the -tau side is a mirror replay, not a second coupling. Item 3: omega_inf equals every AQ1-type subsequential state of the AX1 construction on every finite region, and only then inherits exactly the AX1 gate's route-B list. Item 4: for every coarse translation v and N at least |v|_inf+2, ||rho^{Lambda_N+v}_R-rho^{Lambda_N}_R||_1 <= C_B q^(N-|v|_inf-1) by one direct c5B comparison, and omega_inf is invariant under coarse translations on every finite region by the region form of c5B; nothing is claimed for non-coarse fine translations. Node (AX2 gate sha256 1db36627b9eab00915b0cb38a0e9fd9cf9dd4dbf3ceb7eab969336f3f9f44be4, sub-label reference_unresolved): at tau=+10^-8 and s=1, C_inf(1)=(chi, e^{-G} chi) with chi=(pi(W)-omega_inf(W))Omega in the GNS representation of omega_inf satisfies |C_inf(1)-d| <= R' with d=497870683678639429793424156500617766317/40000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (about 1.24467670920e-2) and R'=1912298807996871790146581299723633/10000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (about 1.91229880800e-7), the AX2 gate rationals, returned exactly by the admitted AX2 calculator at its fixed design (the AX1 bound value D', k'=51|tau|/4, M_0=2, M_1=4s/pi); the free value e^{-3}/4 lies inside [d-R', d+R'], so no interaction shift, sign or coefficient of C(s) is claimed. The tau to tau/100 ratios are 39059948/388073 (about 100.651) for K_B and about 100.661 for C_B, c_site,B, C'_B and c'_site,B. Rates are per coarse step in N at fixed spacing.
limitations: Scope: only the uniform route-B model at fixed spacing and strong bare coupling (|tau| at most 10^-8, g^4 at least 9.6x10^9 by the AL1 dictionary of this model), the named construction FB and the finite complete-factor route-B volumes containing Lambda_N with N at least 2, finite complete-factor regions and the cover R, coarse translations and the single node s=1 at tau=+10^-8; route B has one named family, so no common limit of two route-B families is claimed; nothing transfers to the zero-selected family (no identification with the BB2 limit and no BB1 or BB2 constant applied), to other boundary prescriptions, to weak coupling or the continuum; the constants are uniform in N at fixed spacing and in the on-site cutoff, and no estimate is uniform in the lattice spacing a.

Convergence of the named construction only: no uniqueness of any ground state and no statement about states outside the named construction; the limit is identified only with the AQ1-type subsequential states of the AX1 construction and inherits only the AX1 gate's route-B list; the AX1 finite-volume statement (a simple ground and gap 1/2 in every finite complete-factor route-B volume) is a finite-volume premise, not an infinite-volume statement.

Dynamics: no route-B dynamics comparison and no correlation-function statement (dynamics_level is not exported); stationarity under the route-B limit dynamics T_theta and the GNS generator are inherited properties of the identified state from the AX1 gate (producer reading W6), not a route-B BA2; no equality of GNS dynamics of different states and no uniform-in-time statement; the secondary label static_not_dynamic is read in this sense (state statements and the inherited Euclidean node, no route-B real-time dynamics).

Node restatement only: d and R' are the AX2 gate rationals; the free value e^{-3}/4 lies inside the interval (reference_unresolved); no interaction shift, sign or coefficient of C(s), no other node and no convergence of finite-box nodes C_N(1) to C_inf(1) is claimed, and the -tau value is the U_E mirror replay; the labelled own re-evaluations of the radius (the producer's and the skeptic's, each about 2.7e-41 below R') are cross-checks, not the headline.

Coefficient input: T0 is a statement in each on-site cutoff space (untruncated creation coefficients are not asserted; producer reading W3); only the creation coefficients are continued in the coupling, and no analyticity of the reduced density or of the normalization is claimed (no zero-free region); the analytic steps of the disc lemma (Weierstrass, the maximum principle) and the AM2 majorant steps are proved in the report and are not machine-checked.

Constants are upper bounds only, evaluated at the constants proved in the packet (no hypothesis layer); the thin margins are T0 (about 2.1493) and T2 (about 2.1491), because c_site,B=K_B(2+beta* S_lambda) and the far term is about 1.04e-4 of the near term; the route-A extremes fail the route-B self-map by the factor 29/28 only (producer reading W4); the crude tier fails every target and is retained; the nested-telescoping and union-volume variants, the telescoped coefficient input and the weighted first order (49W+3)|tau|/144 are labelled only.

Rates: every rate is per coarse step in N at fixed spacing (a coarse step is (4a,2a,a)) and holds for every N at least 2 (on a region Y, for every N with Y inside Lambda_N; for the exhaustion, for every N_k at least 2); no correlation-function rate in N and no rate transferred from BB2 is claimed.

Contract wording read as follows (non-blocking): W1 clause 2a's item 1 is the whole-sequence bound T4; W2 (equal to skeptic R5) the sharper vanishing order N-|u|_inf+1 is not substituted; W3 T0 holds only in each Q_L; W4 (equal to skeptic R4) the route-A extremes fail only the self-map, by 29/28; W5 (equal to skeptic R6) with union_comparison T3 carries nothing beyond T1; W6 the inherited AX1 stationarity is not a route-B dynamics claim; W7 the factor 2 of 8*2^{diam I} is absorbed into lambda=2/W; skeptic D1 (T1 has no form field), D2 (c1B is a special case of c4B) and D3 (the inherited parameter control asks for d_X and N_0) stand.

Premises: inherited without re-proof are the AM2 majorant steps and fixed point, the AX1 route-B grouping, finite-volume theorem, state lemma, flip identity and route-B AQ1/AQ2 re-instantiation list, AV1 F20-F23, the AX2 certificate and calculator, and the I1 dictionary; the analytic disc (BA1 reverse Theorem 4.1), the iterated split (BB1 reverse) and the whole-sequence scheme (BB2) are shared premises named by the contract. The producer read parts of the gated BB1 reverse check.py outside its inputs for conventions (disclosed); no BC2 constant depends on it.

Independence: one forward producer plus the skeptic's pre-comparison replay, all correlated model agents; the skeptic pre-comparison package (5ec599f) was committed 3 min 44 s before the forward commit (ee45eed); the pre-comparison rationals equal the producer's exactly because both follow the frozen formula chain, so the agreement checks code and arithmetic, not a second method; isolation rests on disclosure and content; the report was written by a shell heredoc after a briefly written stub (disclosed to the coordinator, not in the frozen packet) and is bound by its freeze record.
model: Uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) at fixed spacing and strong bare coupling handled by route B (AQ_uniform_routeB; every elementary face nu=alpha tau/24; AL1 dictionary tau=96/g^4, g^4=9.6x10^9 at the cap; never weak coupling or continuum), both signs |tau|<=10^-8 with tau<0 the U_E mirror; Haar reference; whole stars and single-factor groups, J'=29|tau|, J_0'=29/10^8 (AX1); the named construction of centered whole-star-plus-single-group boxes Lambda_N, N at least 2, and finite complete-factor route-B volumes containing Lambda_N; reduced densities on finite complete-factor regions, trace norm; coarse l-infinity metric; the original xz Wilson loop and the centered Euclidean correlation at s=1
decision: Admit the route-B re-derivation of the locality and convergence chain and the node restatement for the uniform model's named construction, single direction with the skeptic's independent replay from the contract: coefficient input by analytic_disc on |z| at most 64|tau| (self-map 1073/2734375 below 1/64, contraction 2552/390625; the route-A disc radius and split weight rejected on the route-B self-map test), K_B=13/27941256 (about 4.6526e-7, margin 2.149 against 1/1000000); marginal locality by iterated_split with direct comparisons c1B, c4B, c5B, both signs, each on-site cutoff space uniformly in L and at fixed N for the untruncated vectors: C_B about 9.4516e-7 (margin 4.232 against 1/250000) and c_site,B about 9.3062e-7 (margin 2.149 against 1/500000, the binding margin, with K_B); whole-sequence convergence over all M greater than N by one direct comparison (union_comparison, factor 1): C'_B = C_B and c'_site,B = c_site,B (margin 2.686 against 1/400000), for every N at least 2 (for a region Y, every N with Y inside Lambda_N); the limit on every finite region without compactness; the same limit along every exhausting sequence of finite complete-factor route-B volumes; the pointwise sign mirror omega^{-tau}_inf = omega^{tau}_inf o alpha_E; identification with every AQ1-type subsequential state of the AX1 construction before inheriting the AX1 route-B list; coarse translation invariance with ||rho^{Lambda_N+v}_R-rho^{Lambda_N}_R||_1 <= C_B q^(N-|v|_inf-1) and no claim about non-coarse translations; the AX2 node restated for the limit with d=497870683678639429793424156500617766317/(4*10^40) and R'=1912298807996871790146581299723633/10^40 (about 1.9123e-7) equal to the gate rationals, returned exactly by the admitted AX2 calculator; reference_unresolved; tau -> tau/100 ratios about 100.651 and 100.661; crude tiers retained as failures. Every route-B constant is recomputed from route-B inputs (per-site sum 29|tau|, 52 first-order faces and 5 interaction groups per site, 16 faces inside R); the skeptic's own code reproduces every constant as the same rational (same frozen formula chain: arithmetic and code confirmed, not a second method), and 22 route-A substitutions into the producer's checker abort. Recorded non-blocking: the producer's contract readings (T0 in each Q_L only; the sharper vanishing order not substituted; T3 carries nothing beyond T1 under union comparison; the inherited AX1 stationarity is a property of the identified state, not a route-B dynamics claim); five silent report edits caught only by the skeptic's validator; the report was written through a shell heredoc after a tool refusal and a stub was briefly written; parts of the gated BB1 reverse checker were read for conventions; commit order skeptic 5ec599f before forward ee45eed with the skeptic's values final first. This is convergence of the named construction of the route-B model (one family), not uniqueness of any ground state, not a statement about other boundary conditions or route-B dynamics, not a finite-box node, not weak coupling or continuum and not uniform in the lattice spacing a. Sub-round 3 complete.
